title: Screen a two-call centre share with one rank-8 restoration
body:
## Summary
- The published two-call lever halves the eight rank-8 copies and the centre charge. Its ceiling ratio rounds to 1.90, above the one-tenth stop.
- Charging one rank-8 restoration per pair leaves 9/2 rank-8 children and centre charge 36. The ceiling stays above 11/10 times the selected word. Hosting and precision add no child under the stated hypotheses.
- This is a relaxation screen. It does not build the shared path and does not change the selected exponent.
